meta.title: 1kg Grouper + Giant Seafood Rice | Da Nang's Secret Gem
meta.description:
Discover one of the best hidden seafood restaurants in Da Nang as we explore a local-recommended spot just minutes from the fishing boats near Son Tra Peninsula. After a week of bad weather and illness, the sunshine finally arrives — giving us the perfect chance to hunt down fresh seafood straight from the source.

Tucked away in the back streets, Nan Danh Seafood Restaurant is a huge, mostly local seafood venue you’d never find without insider tips. With fishing boats docked nearby, this place promises some of the freshest seafood in Da Nang — and it delivers.

We order a massive fried grouper (over 1kg) topped with mango, mint, garlic, and chili, alongside a giant seafood fried rice packed with shrimp, squid, and octopus. From crispy fish skin to juicy flesh and the perfect balance of sweet, spicy, and herbal flavors, this meal turns into one of the best seafood experiences we’ve had in Vietnam.

If you’re looking for authentic Da Nang food, local seafood restaurants, hidden gems, and travel tips for Vietnam, this is a must-watch. See what it’s like to eat where the locals eat and why some of the best places aren’t on the tourist map.

In this video:

* Exploring Da Nang’s fishing coastline
* Finding a hidden local seafood restaurant
* Fresh grouper cooked Vietnamese style
* Massive seafood fried rice review
* Honest reactions, prices, and portion sizes
* Why local recommendations beat Google Maps
